title: Bound current-scene prompt transcript
description: Review finding from loreweaver-den. Context assembly loads and renders the current scene transcript in full, which contradicts bounded-context goals and can grow prompt size/cost over long scenes. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Context assembly has deterministic limits for live scene transcript inclusion; tests prove long scenes stay under budget; omitted content remains discoverable through summaries or memory drilldown.
close_reason: Bound current-scene transcript context to a deterministic tail, added omitted-count prompt guidance, and made omitted scene-log windows retrievable through memory_drilldown; verification: npm run typecheck and npm run test passed; TDD evidence recorded.
